### Set-up

```{r read_packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(glue)
library(patchwork)
library(rsvg)
library(grid)
```

### Prepare corpus

```{r}
corpus = read.csv("input_data/corpus_riverfront.csv")

selection = c("Ahmedabad", "Brisbane", "Columbia, South Carolina", "Chanthaburi", "Détroit", "Rabat", "Fort Worth", "Patna", "Varanasi", "Thành Phố Hồ Chí Minh (Hô Chi Minh City)", "Nashville-Davidson", "Belém", "Kuching", "Petrolina", "Posadas", "Porto Alegre", "Melbourne", "Khabarovsk", "Bratislava", "Lyon", "Ottawa", "Gatineau", "Chicago",  "Langfang", "Washington, D.C.", "St. Louis")

corpus = corpus %>% 
  filter(urban_aggl %in% selection) %>% 
  select(c("fid", "urban_aggl", "position", "link", "text", "text_en"))

write.csv(corpus, "results/corpus_riverfronts.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

### Results of the content analysis

```{r}
# selected cities
villes = c("Ahmedabad", "Brisbane", "Columbia, South Carolina", "Chanthaburi", "Détroit", "Rabat", "Fort Worth", "Patna", "Varanasi", "Thành Phố Hồ Chí Minh (Hô Chi Minh City)", "Nashville-Davidson", "Belém", "Kuching", "Petrolina", "Posadas", "Porto Alegre", "Melbourne", "Khabarovsk", "Bratislava", "Lyon", "Ottawa", "Gatineau", "Chicago",  "Langfang", "Washington, D.C.", "St. Louis")

# read corpus which was coded by hand
data = readxl::read_xlsx("results/corpus_codage.xlsx") %>% 
  filter(urban_aggl %in% villes) %>% 
  select(-c("fid", "position", "link", "text", "text_en")) %>% 
  mutate(urban_aggl = case_when(
    urban_aggl == "Ottawa" ~ "Ottawa-Gatineau",
    urban_aggl == "Gatineau" ~ "Ottawa-Gatineau",
    urban_aggl == "Thành Phố Hồ Chí Minh (Hô Chi Minh City)" ~ "Ho Chi Minh City",
    TRUE ~ urban_aggl
  ))

data_n_pages = data %>% 
  group_by(urban_aggl) %>% 
  mutate(n_pages = n()) %>% 
  select(c("urban_aggl", "n_pages")) %>% 
  unique()

data_sum = data %>% 
  group_by(urban_aggl) %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>% 
  left_join(data_n_pages, by = "urban_aggl") %>% 
  mutate(across(2:18, ~ .x/n_pages*100))

write.csv(data_sum, "results/data_corpus.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

### Plots

```{r}
thematics = data.frame(thematic = c("Loisirs, tourisme", "Nature","Parc",
                                    "Monument", "Industrie",
                                    "Commerces, restaurants", "Chemin, promenade",
                                    "Valeur esthétique", "Hors-sujet",
                                    "Navigation", "Aménagement, accès à l'eau",
                                    "Résidentiel", "Enjeux environnementaux",
                                    "Religion", "Inondation", 
                                    "Critique du projet","Aménité"),
                       i = 1:17,
                       mycolor = c("#f781bf", "#b3de69", "#f781bf", "#f781bf",
                                   "#bf812d", "#f781bf", "#8dd3c7", "#ccebc5",
                                   "lightgrey", "#8dd3c7", "#8dd3c7", "#eac1f7",
                                   "#b3de69", "#fb8072", "#ccebc5", "#ccebc5", 
                                   "#fdb462"))

all_cities = sort(unique(data_sum$urban_aggl), decreasing = FALSE)
```

#### Order by alphabetical order of cities

##### Individual plots 

```{r def_barplot_function}
thematic_barplot_alpha = function(thematic, i, mycolor){
  
  print(thematic)
  
  data = data_sum[,c(1,i+1)] 
  colnames(data) = c("urban_aggl", "theme")
  
  data$urban_aggl = factor(data$urban_aggl, levels = rev(all_cities))
  
  # read file 
  data %>% 
      ggplot(aes(x = theme,
                 y = urban_aggl)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity",
               fill = mycolor) +
      xlim(0, 100) +
      labs(title = thematic,
           y = "",
           x = "%") +
      theme_bw()
      
  ggsave(glue("results/content_analysis_alphabetical/barplot_theme_{i}.svg"), width = 2000, height = 1300, units = "px")

  print("barplot saved")
}
```

```{r}
pmap(list(thematics$thematic, thematics$i, thematics$mycolor),
     thematic_barplot_alpha)
```

##### Big/combined plot

```{r}
make_big_barplot = function(thematic, i, mycolor){
  
  print(thematic)
  
  data = data_sum[,c(1,i+1)] 
  colnames(data) = c("urban_aggl", "theme")
  
  data$urban_aggl = factor(data$urban_aggl, levels = rev(all_cities))
  
  # read file 
  data %>% 
      ggplot(aes(x = theme,
                 y = urban_aggl)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity",
               fill = mycolor) +
      xlim(0, 100) +
      labs(title = thematic,
           y = "",
           x = "%") +
      theme_bw()
}

plot_list = pmap(list(thematics$thematic, thematics$i, thematics$mycolor),
                 make_big_barplot)
wrap_plots(plot_list, nrow = 6, ncol = 3)

ggsave("results/content_analysis_alphabetical/barplot_alpha3.svg", width = 350, height = 550, units = "mm")
```

### 

```{r}
# Let's get the percentage of pages which are about riverfronts or waterfronts in the corpus.

corpus = read.csv("input_data/corpus.csv") 

data_corpus = corpus %>% 
  select(urban_aggl) %>% 
  filter(urban_aggl %in% c("Ahmedabad", "Brisbane", "Columbia, South Carolina", "Chanthaburi", "Détroit", "Rabat", "Fort Worth", "Patna", "Varanasi", "Thành Phố Hồ Chí Minh (Hô Chi Minh City)", "Nashville-Davidson", "Belém", "Kuching", "Petrolina", "Posadas", "Porto Alegre", "Melbourne", "Khabarovsk", "Bratislava", "Lyon", "Ottawa", "Gatineau", "Chicago",  "Langfang", "Washington, D.C.", "St. Louis")) %>% 
  mutate(urban_aggl = case_when(
    urban_aggl == "Ottawa" ~ "Ottawa-Gatineau",
    urban_aggl == "Gatineau" ~ "Ottawa-Gatineau",
    urban_aggl == "Thành Phố Hồ Chí Minh (Hô Chi Minh City)" ~ "Ho Chi Minh City",
    TRUE ~ urban_aggl
  )) %>% 
  group_by(urban_aggl) %>% 
  summarise(n_corpus = n()) %>% 
  left_join(data_sum[,c(1,19)], by = "urban_aggl") %>% 
  mutate(perc_pages = n_pages/n_corpus*100) %>% 
  select(c("urban_aggl", "perc_pages"))

write.csv(data_corpus, "results/data_corpus_perc_pages.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
